description: Redux reducers for managing scheduled posts state in Mattermost, including handling received, updated, and deleted scheduled posts across different entities (byId, byTeamId, byChannelOrThreadId, errorsByTeamId).

methods.name: byId
methods.description: Reducer handling scheduled posts indexed by their ID, updating state based on received, updated, or deleted posts.

methods.name: byTeamId
methods.description: Reducer managing scheduled posts grouped by team ID, handling addition, removal, and updates of posts per team.

methods.name: errorsByTeamId
methods.description: Reducer tracking error states for scheduled posts per team, updating on receive and delete actions.

methods.name: byChannelOrThreadId
methods.description: Reducer managing scheduled posts indexed by channel or thread ID, supporting prune and update operations.
